watch.summary: A streamer passionately reacts and yells in excitement while watching a tense Valorant esports match where player Timotino pulls off a big play.

beats.what: Streamer screams 'LET'S GO' while hyping up player Timotino.
Footage shows the spike being planted as casters describe the round.
Timotino makes a clutch move and the streamer jumps out of his seat celebrating.
Round ends and the streamer realizes in confusion that he was rooting for the wrong player.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Wait a minute, wait a minute, I think I was rooting for the wrong person!
watch.why: This clip relies heavily on excitement and hype surrounding a professional Valorant match rather than comedy. Without understanding the teams and match context, a casual viewer only sees an energetic overreaction to a video game moment.
